templates.name: Before / After
templates.description: Before/after transformation reveal from two photos or clips: a full-screen swipe from before to after, or a labelled top/bottom split. For glow-ups, makeovers, results, edits and app redesigns.

source.notes: Swipe-reveal transformation posts: hook on top, lowercase before/after labels in TikTok's native text box.

How long the after holds once revealed (split without --reveal: the reel length); default 3–8s from the media

Which way the swipe travels

Vertical focus kept in frame (split halves crop a lot: lower = keep the top)

templates.name: Numbered Listicle
templates.description: "3 apps that feel illegal to know" countdown: a hook title card, then numbered items — each with its own clip or photo, title and optional note — and an optional CTA. Optional beat-synced cuts.

source.notes: Tool/app/tips lists: native text titles, one item per 2–4s, best item last, CTA asks which one they'll try (comment bait).

templates.name: …but no yapping
templates.description: Silent split-screen tutorial: a fullscreen intro under an outcome hook ("making $10k but no yapping"), then typing footage over a screen recording with short step captions on the seam. Farms saves and shares.

source.notes: Mouth-tape intro → 50/50 typing/demo split, lowercase step captions centred on the seam, no voiceover.

templates.name: Talking head + word captions

source.notes: Hormozi/CapCut-style auto captions: 1–3 heavy words at a time under the chin, spoken word in yellow, zoom on every other sentence.

templates.name: Wall of Text over B-roll
templates.description: POV / storytime / confession: a long first-person text in TikTok's native white text box over looping b-roll, with an optional second card (the reveal). The go-to organic app-promo format.

source.notes: Native TikTok text tool (Classic font, white background) over aesthetic b-roll; the text takes longer to read than the video lasts, so viewers rewatch.

playbook.description: The producer's playbook for short-form reels (TikTok / Reels / Shorts) made with reelclaw templates, from a product brief to postable videos — pick the format and template, write scroll-stopping hooks, choose footage and music, make the reel, QA every render frame by frame, and spin up variants. Use when planning reels or a content batch, writing or fixing hooks, choosing footage or a sound, checking a render before delivery, making hook variants, or when the user says "make N reels / ads for my app", "make my reels go viral", or isn't sure which template fits.
